units.H: cold validation: exact admission, member hashes, manifest/I02/root checks, footer census
units.S: session index build: all event and side-family row groups, full body decode/truth check, temp events/members SQLite + indexes
units.Q: scientific counting per operation: all-universe routing/predicate/target/weight evaluation
units.O: evidence output per operation: fact with risk/denominator member refs, provenance, authorities, replay, cell projection; I05 receipts/support
units.I: validation of a durable derived index (digest + binding checks, not rebuild)
units.N: distinct issued operations in the workload

cost_laws.index_aware_pushdown: H + I + N*(q+O), q<Q only if exact candidate streams preserve semantics
cost_laws.i05_discovery: sum over candidates and roles of execute_empirical_query cost + frontier/receipt output; frontier fixed before results
cost_laws.f1_f4_composition: one producer execute_empirical_query per direct route plus evidence/consumer construction; forward/reverse/joint routes are separate operations

evidence_output_refs.label: analytic_inference
evidence_output_refs.equation: O_refs ~ 2*R ExactRefs per fact (risk + denominator) + provenance/authority/cell/replay
evidence_output_refs.estimate: at R=100000 and ~150-250 bytes per serialized ExactRef, ~15-25 MB per fact before provenance; 100 distinct facts ~1.5-2.5 GB
evidence_output_refs.caveat: must be measured; not a measured output size
